description: Search rule34.xxx for posts carrying a tag, or several tags at once. Tags are written as one token, so a name said as words is joined by underscores: 'asuka langley sohryu' and 'ranma 1/2' are single tags, and this tool joins them for you. Returns each post's page, its image or video URL, dimensions, score and rating, alongside the number of posts the whole search matches. A row shows the first 12 of a post's tags and says how many it has; call get_post for the whole list with a kind for every tag. Use 'media_type' to ask for still images, animations or video; the site classifies these itself. When a search finds nothing, the answer names the tags rule34.xxx does not hold, or says how many posts the tags match once the restrictions are dropped.

any_of.description: Tags a post must carry at least one of.

exclude.description: Tags a post must not carry, such as ['monochrome'] to leave out black and white.

media_type.description: 'image' for stills, 'animated' for GIFs, 'video' for MP4. The site states this in its own tags, so the classification is as good as the tagging.

rating.description: The two ratings rule34.xxx holds. Leave unset to search both.

sort.description: 'score' is the site's own tally of votes, recomputed once a day. 'id' is newest first. 'updated' is by when a post last changed, which retagging moves. 'random' draws a different set on each call.

tags.description: Tags a post must all carry, such as ['asuka langley sohryu', 'black hair'].

name: search_posts

any_of.description: The alternatives, as rule34.xxx spells them.

exclude.description: The excluded tags, as rule34.xxx spells them.

created_at.description: When the post was added to rule34.xxx, ISO 8601. The site imported much of its older catalogue in bulk, so thousands of posts share one day.

file_url.description: The image or video itself, on the site's CDN.

post_url.description: The rule34.xxx page for this post.

preview_url.description: Thumbnail, when the site published one.

rating.description: As the site holds it: 'explicit' or 'questionable'.

sample_url.description: Reduced copy, when the site published one.

score.description: The site's own score, updated once a day.

source.description: Whatever the uploader credited, when they credited any.

tags.description: The first tags of the post, at most 12 of them.

tags_total.description: How many tags the post carries in all.

query.description: The search as it was sent, in the site's own language.

tags.description: The required tags, as rule34.xxx spells them.

total.description: Posts the whole search matches, as counted by the site.

title: Search posts by tag
